difficulty_reason: The new obligation is a field-independent transfer from resolution width to PCR monomial space after a non-authoritarian substitution. Its human proof constructs whole flippable assignment blocks from a winning pebble-game strategy and verifies one-block extension despite a clause spanning several original variables. That structured-family bridge, including preservation under restrictions, is the nonroutine core; the Atserias–Dalmau width characterization and Bonacina–Galesi space theorem are precisely attributed prerequisites.
